groups.name: Group name

variants.title: Variants
variants.subtitle: Variant groups are shared by many services. The customer picks one option from each group; its price is added to the service's price.
variants.defaultHint: The option selected when the service opens
variants.name: Name
variants.emptyDescription: Make a group such as Size or Speed once, then use it on many services.
variants.pickOneNote: The customer picks exactly one option; mark which one is selected by default.
variants.detailSubtitle: The options in this group and the services that use it.
variants.createSubtitle: Make a variant group: the customer picks one option, and its price is added to the service's price.
variants.editSubtitle: Change the variant group; it applies to every service that uses it.

modifiers.title: Modifiers
modifiers.subtitle: Modifier groups are shared by many services. They hold extra choices with a minimum and a maximum.
modifiers.emptyDescription: Make a group of extras such as Fragrance or Add-ons, with a minimum and a maximum.
modifiers.minHint: 0 makes the group optional; 1 or more makes it required.
modifiers.detailSubtitle: The choices in this group, its rule, and the services that use it.
modifiers.createSubtitle: Make a modifier group: extra choices with a minimum and a maximum.
modifiers.editSubtitle: Change the modifier group; it applies to every service that uses it.

groups.numberInvalid: Enter a number of 0 or more
groups.maxInvalid: The most must be a whole number of 1 or more, or empty for no limit
groups.notesHint: Tells apart groups that share a name. Never shown to customers.
